en: Dependent on a state that is neither-root-cause, neither-visible, nor impinging, a state that is rootless, visible, and impinging arises by way of root-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither-root-cause, neither-visible, nor impinging, a state that is rootless, visible, and impinging arises by way of root-condition … one.
(By calculation there are three questions. Abbreviated. Under root-condition.
Three by way of predominance; ... pe ... three by way of non-disappearance.

(In the case of the root that is not-root-conditioned, non-visible, and impinging, there are likewise only three. Three by way of root; three by way of predominance; ... pe ... one by way of mutuality; ... pe ... three by way of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not-root-conditioned, non-visible, and non-impinging, there arises a state that is rootless, non-visible, and non-impinging, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One by way of root; one by way of predominance; ... pe ... one by way of non-disappearance.

(The "not-root-associated, not-non-shown, with-resistance" [category] is similar to the "root-caused dyad. There are three questions. No questions are obtained in the "root-root-caused dyad" nor in the "root-root-associated dyad.")
